description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Redwire Space Missions, LLC develops technologies that support the expansion of humanity’s presence in space. The Software Engineer will design, test, and integrate simulation and test software used to validate flight software, Guidance, Navigation, and Control algorithms, and satellite operations. The role collaborates with flight software, systems engineering, and electrical engineering teams to assemble digital twins and flat satellites.
Satellite simulation and test software engineer validating flight software, GN&C algorithms, and spacecraft operations through digital twins and HIL testing

Responsibilities:
• Develop, maintain, and configure simulation and test software to meet requirements for validating flight software, GN&C algorithms, and general satellite operation
• Translate system requirements for digital twins and flat sats into software architectures, designs, and implementations
• Create component emulators which will be used to validate flight software modules and execute mission day in the life tests
• Implement or adapt test software to execute full verification and validation tests on the spacecraft during assembly, integration, and test (AI&T) operations
• Work with electrical engineering to design a flat sat which is an accurate representation of the spacecraft
• Perform unit, integration, and system-level software testing, including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) environments
• Document project progress, software design, implementation, and testing processes
• Adhere to all safety protocols and procedures while working with the test bench unit
• Assist with troubleshooting technical issues with simulation and test software systems
• Use software development best practices and version control procedures
• Ensure compliance with aerospace quality standards and configuration management processes
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams including systems, avionics, and mission operations

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
• Proficiency in C++ and Python
• Proficiency with Linux and shell scripting
• Experience working with real time systems
• Familiarity with spacecraft avionics interfaces and protocols (e.g., MIL-STD-1553, CAN, SpaceWire, RS-422, Ethernet)
• Experience with Object Oriented software development
• Experience with version control systems (Git, SVN) and issue tracking tools (JIRA)
• Must be a US Citizen with the ability to obtain a security clearance
• you must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State

Preferred:
• Familiarity with Maven and CMake for dependency management and builds
• Experience working with hardware-in-the-loop, including mission critical hardware
• Experience with modeling and simulation
• Familiarity with basic aerospace principles and satellite design
• Experience working in an Agile development environment
• Experience with containers (Docker, Podman, Kubernetes) and microservices
• Strong communication and organizational skills
